verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the title of a dedicated 'User Memory' documentation page. That suggests LibreChat ships a per-user memory feature, but nothing in the pack describes how it works. The RAG item covers uploaded files, not memory of the user, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: evidence that memory persists across sessions, evidence that the assistant writes and recalls memories automatically, any description of how memory is managed, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
